C1416.title: Crypto Lending Protocol Themis Hit by Oracle Manipulation Attack
C1416.summary: On June 28, 2023, the Themis lending protocol suffered a flash-loan price manipulation attack. Security analyses said the attacker borrowed substantial assets from Aave, used trades to distort a price calculation consumed by Themis, then borrowed other assets against the inflated collateral valuation before repaying the flash loan. The attacker ultimately made approximately $370,000, illustrating the risk of using manipulable on-chain prices as oracle inputs.
